key_findings: Exercise after thoracic contusion SCI in rats alleviated mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia and restored KCC2, GAD 65+67 and VGluT1 in the lumbar dorsal horn.
Exercise reduced CGRP-labeled nociceptive afferent sprouting and enhanced rate-dependent depression of the H-reflex.
